# UmanoAI — AI, automation and software for SMEs in Argentina

> UmanoAI is an Argentine company that develops and implements artificial-intelligence agents, automation and software for small and medium-sized businesses.

UmanoAI works with SMEs, service businesses, retail companies and professionals in Argentina. Its work includes AI agents connected to WhatsApp Business, process automation, web development, integrations, voice agents, dashboards and UmanoSoft.

## Services

### AI agents for WhatsApp Business

UmanoAI implements agents that can answer initial questions, qualify leads, hand conversations to people and connect to systems according to each project’s scope. The WhatsApp implementation uses Meta’s WhatsApp Cloud API.

### Process automation

UmanoAI designs administrative and commercial workflows that can connect APIs, CRM systems, ERP systems, Google Sheets, forms and WhatsApp. n8n and Power Automate are used when appropriate to the existing stack.

### Web development

UmanoAI develops business websites and landing pages with contact forms, WhatsApp, analytics and integrations when required.

### UmanoSoft

UmanoSoft is UmanoAI’s management software for SMEs. Its published capabilities include AFIP electronic invoicing, CRM, quotes, expense control, goals and tasks.

### Practical training for companies

UmanoAI provides practical training for sales and administrative teams on applied AI, task and process automation, Power BI, and WhatsApp assistants and agents. Content is adapted to each company's context with concrete examples and exercises.

## Founder and teaching experience

Juan José Galván is the founder of UmanoAI and has more than 20 years of experience at multinational companies in Argentina's agricultural sector.

He taught a guest class in Universidad Austral's Programa en Gestión de Ventas de Agroinsumos on artificial intelligence, automation, Power BI and WhatsApp agents applied to agricultural sales management.

- Official program: https://www.austral.edu.ar/rosario/posgrados/agronegocios/pca/
- Experience post: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7510761153782767616/

## Community commitment

UmanoAI's contributions policy starts on October 1, 2026 and is not retroactive. From October through December 2026, UmanoAI will allocate 5% of revenue actually collected, excluding taxes, to Banco de Alimentos Buenos Aires. Starting in 2027, the annual percentage will be between 1% and 5%, defined and published before each year begins. This is UmanoAI's own commitment and does not imply a partnership, agreement, sponsorship or endorsement by Banco de Alimentos Buenos Aires.
